usedFor: Shopify holds your products and Raven Tools tracks keywords, so “New Product” can feed “Create Keyword”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Keyword” in Raven Tools
bestTemplate.why: Each new product can add a keyword to the domain you track, so new items are watched early.

watchOut: “Remove Keyword” deletes a keyword from the domain, so use it with “Order Paid” only on purpose.
